'''MCR-99 reconnaissance droids''' were [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] used by [[The Shroud (Human)|The Shroud]] to conduct surveillance on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] alike. They were [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] powered droids secreted in remote locations on numerous worlds where they remained in place for long periods.

After the Shroud's activities in the [[Galactic War]] became known to the Empire and Republic, the MCR-99 droids were located by spacers working for both sides using [[EV2 discreet reconnaissance macrobinoculars]].

==Behind the scenes==
MCR-99 droids are hidden objects that were added to the game world of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']] expansion. They are found on every storyline planet and can be located using the macrobinoculars function. The droids have no active gameplay function but are part of the game's achievement system.
